luipy-utils-mod.config.title: Luipy Utils
luipy-utils-mod.config.block_highlight_e: Emphasize matching blocks in the world with a bright overlay (Client side).
luipy-utils-mod.config.block_highlight_i: Comma+space separated resource ids, e.g. redstone_ore, gravel, calcite, clay.
luipy-utils-mod.config.block_highlight.t: Could not load that PNG for the highlight texture.
luipy-utils-mod.config.master_enabled.de: Master switch for all Luipy Utils client features.
luipy-utils-mod.config.show_ender_with_i: Ender chest panel in unified menu
Show a 3×9 ender chest panel in the unified menu (R).
luipy-utils-mod.config.show_ender_gate_h: Show an ender chest icon left of the hotbar when ender access is available.
luipy-utils-mod.config.always_virtual.de: Skip item and block gates when opening the virtual ender chest.
luipy-utils-mod.config.require_item.desc: Require holding an ender chest item unless always-virtual is enabled.
luipy-utils-mod.config.require_block: Gate: require nearby Ender Chest block
luipy-utils-mod.config.require_block.des: Require a loaded ender chest block nearby unless always-virtual is enabled.
luipy-utils-mod.config.show_toasts.desc: Print failure messages to chat when a feature cannot run.
luipy-utils-mod.config.enchantment_previ: Hovering an enchantment option lists every enchantment that will be applied.
luipy-utils-mod.config.open_shulker_from: Shift+right-click a shulker box in your inventory to open it.
luipy-utils-mod.config.show_crafting_tab: Crafting table panel in unified menu
Show a 3×3 crafting table panel in the unified menu (R).
luipy-utils-mod.config.keybind.open_conf: Hold both keys at the same time in-game or from the pause menu.
luipy-utils-mod.config.keybind.open_unif: Opens or closes the unified menu.
key.luipy-utils-mod.open_config: Open Luipy Utils config (hold X + R)

luipy-utils-mod.message.unified_creative: The unified menu is not available in Creative mode.
luipy-utils-mod.message.ender_gate_no_ru: Ender chest panel is on but no gate rules are enabled — enable an item or block gate, or turn on always allow.
luipy-utils-mod.message.ender_gate_need_: Need an ender chest in your inventory to open the unified menu.

luipy-utils-mod.message.shulker_requires: Opening shulkers from inventory needs this mod on the server (or singleplayer with the mod).
luipy-utils-mod.message.shulker_carrying: Put down the item on your cursor before opening a shulker box.
luipy-utils-mod.message.shulker_spectato: Cannot open shulker boxes in Spectator mode.
